const fs=require('node:fs');(async()=>{const run=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('/results/aff4b8b4-88a3-40c4-98da-0d60f3af0b10/run.json'));if(!run.complete||!run.success)throw Error('Candidate not passed');const r=await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:'+(process.env.PORT||8082)+'/status',{headers:{authorization:'Bearer '+process.env.BENCH_CONTROL_TOKEN}});if(!r.ok||(await r.json()).running)throw Error('Active job');for(const[n,b]of Object.entries({"internal/storage/fs/capacity.go": "", "internal/storage/fs/capacity_read.go": "", "benchmark/active-plan.json": "", "benchmark/scan-measure.mjs": ""})){fs.writeFileSync('/app/'+n,Buffer.from(b,'base64'));fs.chownSync('/app/'+n,10001,10001)}for(const v of ['before','after'])fs.rmSync('/app/benchmark/scan-'+v+'.test',{force:true});console.log('Installed exact measured candidate for final 23 gates and longer comparison')})().catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exit(1)})
